notes.title: DENKI BOUNCE - Developer Livestream.
notes.notes:
As part of the Steam Game Festival - Learn more about "Denki Bounce" due for release in late Summer 2020. Watch the devs/game creators demonstrate the fundamentals of the gameplay and play some matches!
Please Check out the store page to "follow" or add to your wishlist today! :)
